# Measure Findings: Lead Hub Branding
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

**Result:** Conditional local pass. Source, asset, automated, migration, build, and HTTP checks pass. Browser visual, responsive, and staging acceptance remain open, and production release is not authorized.

## Scope and Security

- The change is limited to portal-facing identity and display treatment.
- `LeadLab Growth Series` and `LeadLab Director` remain unchanged.
- No routes, data model, authorization boundary, storage path, package identity, repository identity, deployment image name, or production configuration changed.
- No credentials, private keys, tokens, cookies, or participant data were added to the run.
- Historical control records, legacy technical identifiers, and generated `storage/inertia-devtools` traces were not rewritten.

## Decision Boundary

The local implementation is suitable for staging handoff. It is not a browser-accepted or production-accepted release. Staging processes must reload the supplied environment values, and staging plus final LeadLab Director acceptance remain separate launch gates.

## Action Disposition

ACT-62 (Prepare and implement the portal-only Lead Hub rename only after separate PM implementation authorization) has completed its authorized local implementation and automated verification. ACT-51 (Complete visual verification of the approved supplied LeadLab logo treatment) is superseded for the former CHG-33 asset by the final CHG-42 asset; its closure is recorded by explicit PM direction, not by claiming unperformed browser review.
